create_crop_boundary_augmentation: create a CropBoundary augmentation that crops N pixels from each side of an image
create_pad_transform: create a PadTransform to pad an image to a larger size with a specified pad mode and value
create_pad_to_square_augmentation: create a PadToSquare augmentation that pads an image to a square shape with a given pad value
create_random_instance_crop_augmentation: create a RandomInstanceCrop augmentation that crops around a random instance with a configurable scale range
create_crop_box_augmentation: create a CropBoxAug augmentation that crops an image around a bounding box with an optional scale factor
